# Reserved-by-qualification fixture (first half)

The discovered name here is `plugins`, which reserves nothing. It only becomes
the reserved index name once cogbox qualifies it: installed as plugin `cogbox`,
this copy would be placed at `cogbox-plugins`, exactly where the generated
capability index is linked. See the sibling fixture root for the second
provider that forces the qualification.
